pattern: ^SELECT min\(\(.*\)\) FROM ([A-Za-z0-9]+) AS [A-Za-z0-9]+ WHERE \[([A-Za-z0-9]+)\] NOT IN \(( SELECT student_id|friend_id FROM Friend UNION ALL SELECT student_id|friend_id FROM Friend \)\)
correction: Join the Friend and Highschooler tables on the id column, and filter out students who are friends with any student in the Highschooler table.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries where a subquery is incorrectly used to filter out rows from another table, and suggests joining the tables directly instead.
